services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new boiler installations, we handle all your plumbing and heating needs with speed and reliability.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast, any time of day or night. We arrive equipped to diagnose and repair most faults on the first visit.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted with full system testing and handover. We advise on efficiency ratings and help you choose the right model for your home.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler service keeps your heating efficient and safe. Emergency repair calls handled with priority dispatch.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full central heating systems designed and installed. We handle radiators, pipework, and controls with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Cold radiators bled and balanced, or replaced with modern efficient units. Quick turnaround keeps your home warm.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Taps, cisterns, and supply pipework fitted to your new suite or as replacements. All work guaranteed and left clean and tidy.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like it's our own home. No cowboys, no surprises, just honest work.
about_para_1: JB Plumbing & Heating has been serving Wolverhampton and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that honest, skilled plumbing shouldn't cost a fortune, we've built our reputation by turning up on time, fixing problems properly, and treating customers' homes with respect. Today we've completed over 2,000 jobs and remain one of the area's most trusted independent plumbers.
about_para_2: Customers choose us because we answer the phone, we arrive fast, and we tell you the real cost upfront—no hidden charges or surprise invoices. Whether it's a frozen pipe at midnight or a new boiler installation, we bring the same professionalism and care to every job. Many of our customers have been with us for years, and they trust us because we've never let them down.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About JB Plumbing

reviews.text: Called JB at 11 p.m. on a Sunday with a burst pipe under the kitchen sink. He was here by midnight and had it sorted by 1 a.m. Brilliant service, fair price, and he didn't make a mess. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler fitted by JB last month. Explained everything clearly, turned up on time, and the install was done in a day with minimal fuss. System's running beautifully and our heating bills are already noticeably lower.
reviews.author: Caroline H.

reviews.text: Five radiators needed balancing and one radiator replaced. JB diagnosed the problem straight away, quoted a fair price, and finished the job the same day. He's tidied up after himself and left everything working perfectly. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David L.
